metadata.title: NOKI Finance
metadata.description: NOKI internal Finance backoffice: COD, cash handovers, cash sessions, variances and reconciliations.

errors.forbiddenDescription: Your account does not have the Finance permissions required to access this page.

session.expiredNotice: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

branding.headline: The NOKI network's Finance backoffice
branding.subtext: COD, cash handovers, cash sessions, variances and reconciliations — for authorized NOKI internal Finance staff only.

login.subtitle: Sign in with your internal NOKI Finance account.

errors.configurationMissing: Service configuration unavailable. Contact an administrator.
errors.serviceUnavailable: Service temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
errors.timeout: The service is taking too long to respond. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again shortly.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to perform this action.
errors.conflict: This action conflicts with the resource's current state.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.description: Real-time Finance KPIs: COD, cash, sessions, variances and payouts.

states.emptyDescription: No Finance metrics are available for your current scope.
states.errorDescription: Unable to load Finance data from NOKI API. Retry or contact support with the reference below.
states.sessionStatusNote: Only the open session count is aggregated by this metric. See Cash sessions for the full detail.
states.varianceNote: Aggregate of open variances only. See Variances for a prioritized list.

list.title: COD collections
list.description: Real COD collections, filterable by country, currency, status and search.

empty.title: No COD collection
empty.description: No COD collection matches these filters.

detail.title: COD collection detail
detail.description: Full collection cycle, from expected amount to reconciliation.
detail.unresolvedStep: Not available here — see the related cash handover
detail.reachedNoAmount: Reached (amount not available on this record)

list.title: Cash handovers
list.description: Real COD cash handovers for your organization/country scope.

empty.title: No cash handover
empty.description: No cash handover matches these filters.
empty.noScopeDescription: No Finance organization/country scope is available on your account.

detail.title: Handover detail
detail.description: Lines, amounts, and available actions for this cash handover.

receive.title: Receive handover
receive.noOpenSession: No compatible open cash session is available.

create.title: New cash handover
create.description: Select the eligible COD collections and enter the handed-over amount for each.
create.noEligible: No eligible COD collection (Declared status) is currently available.
create.validationError: Select at least one COD collection.

list.title: Cash sessions
list.description: Real cash sessions for your organization/country scope.

empty.title: No cash session
empty.description: No cash session matches these filters.
empty.noScopeDescription: No Finance organization/country scope is available on your account.

detail.title: Session detail
detail.description: Amounts, variance, and available actions for this cash session.
detail.handoversNote: Cash handovers received into this session can be reviewed from the Cash handovers page.

create.title: Open a cash session
create.description: Select the currency and enter the opening cash float.
create.validationError: Select a currency and enter an amount.

close.title: Close session
close.previewWarning: The server remains the source of truth — the actual variance is computed on submit.

list.title: Variances
list.description: Real cash variances for your organization/country scope.

empty.title: No variance
empty.noScopeDescription: No Finance organization/country scope is available on your account.

detail.title: Variance detail
detail.description: Amounts, status, and resolution available for this variance.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.unavailableNote: You are not allowed to resolve this variance.
resolution.confirmDescription: This action is final. Do you confirm the decision and reason entered?

list.title: Reconciliations
list.description: Real reconciliations for your organization/country scope.

empty.title: No reconciliation
empty.noScopeDescription: No Finance organization/country scope is available on your account.

detail.title: Reconciliation detail
detail.description: Amounts, status, and available actions for this reconciliation.
detail.preparerNotExposed: Preparer: not exposed by the API
detail.approverNotExposed: Approver: not exposed by the API
detail.linkedVariancesNote: Variances linked to this reconciliation can be reviewed from the Variances page.
detail.makerCheckerNote: The maker/checker separation is enforced server-side: the submitter cannot also approve.
detail.noActionAvailable: No action is available for this reconciliation in its current status.

create.title: New reconciliation
create.description: Select a closed cash session to reconcile.
create.noEligible: No eligible closed cash session is currently available.

list.title: Financial obligations
list.description: Real financial obligations for your organization, with server-computed allocations and balances.

empty.title: No obligations
empty.description: No financial obligation matches these criteria.
empty.noScopeDescription: No Finance organization scope is available on your account.

detail.title: Obligation detail
detail.description: Amounts, status and server-side allocations for this obligation.
detail.gapNotice: Individual allocation records are not exposed by the API (only the aggregated allocated amount is) -- only creating a new allocation is possible.

list.title: Financial disputes
list.description: Look up a dispute by id, or open a new one.

disputes.gapNotice: Disputes have no list or report endpoint on the API -- only lookup by id and creation are available.

detail.title: Dispute detail
detail.description: Effects, status and resolution for this dispute.
detail.heldNotice: The linked obligation is currently held while this dispute is open.
detail.releasedNotice: The hold on the linked obligation was released on resolution.

create.title: Open a dispute
create.description: Opening a dispute on an existing obligation automatically holds that obligation.
create.holdNotice: Opening this dispute will hold the linked obligation until it is resolved.

resolve.adjustmentIdRequired: The adjustment id is required for an adjustment resolution.

list.title: Payment methods
list.description: Governed payment methods for your counterparties.

detail.title: Payment method detail
detail.description: Status, version and available actions for this method.

create.title: New payment method
create.description: Create a new payment method version from an already-vaulted opaque reference.
create.destinationMaskedHint: Must already be a masked string (e.g. **** 4242) -- never a raw IBAN or account number.
create.sensitiveReferenceHint: Must be an opaque reference like vault:..., token:... or pmref:... -- never a raw IBAN, bank account, or phone number.

sensitive.revealedLabel: Access confirmed by the server; the raw reference is not displayed.

empty.title: No payment methods
empty.description: No payment method matches these criteria.
empty.noScopeDescription: No Finance organization scope is available on your account.

fees.gapNotice: Fee rules can be created and inspected by ID; the API does not expose a fee-rule list endpoint.

empty.title: No fees
empty.description: No fee assessment matches these filters.
empty.noScopeDescription: No Finance organization/country scope is available for your account.

list.title: Fee rules
list.description: Create a fee rule or look up an existing rule by identifier.

lookup.label: Fee rule ID
lookup.notFoundHint: Paste an existing fee rule identifier.

create.title: New fee rule
create.description: Create a draft fee rule from server-supported fields only.

detail.title: Fee rule detail
detail.description: Rule scope, calculation fields, status and version.

list.title: Fee assessments
list.description: Assessed fees from the real Finance reports endpoint.
list.missingReportCapability: Fee assessment listing requires report read permission.
list.missingFeeCapability: You can preview rows but cannot open fee assessment details without fee read permission.

create.title: Assess a fee
create.description: Assess a fee against an existing financial obligation.

detail.title: Fee assessment detail
detail.description: Server-provided calculation fields and linked obligation.

documents.gapNotice: The API exposes invoice reporting plus direct document lookup for statements and credit notes; this page does not invent an all-documents list.
documents.statementNotice: This document is a statement, a settlement record, not a new invoice.

list.title: Financial documents
list.description: Invoices from the real reports endpoint, with direct lookup for statements and credit notes.

empty.title: No documents
empty.noScopeDescription: No Finance organization/country scope is available for your account.

create.title: Generate document
create.description: Generate an invoice, statement or credit note from API-authorized criteria only.

detail.title: Document detail
detail.description: Summary, lines, allocations and server totals for this document.

list.title: Financial adjustments
list.description: Create an adjustment or open an existing adjustment by identifier.

empty.title: No adjustment workflow
empty.noScopeDescription: No Finance organization/country scope is available for your account.
empty.createForbiddenDescription: You can look up existing adjustments, but you do not have permission to create one.

detail.title: Adjustment detail
detail.description: Author, approval state, reason and resulting obligation when exposed by the API.
detail.author: Author

list.title: Approval queue
list.description: Pending Finance approvals composed from existing resource endpoints.

empty.title: No approvals
empty.description: No item is waiting in this section.
empty.noScopeDescription: No Finance organization/country scope is available for your account.

sections.adjustmentsGapNotice: Adjustments do not expose a list endpoint in the current API; use the adjustment lookup to approve a known item.

blockedReasons.samePreparer: Blocked if the actor is the preparer.
blockedReasons.sameFirstApprover: Blocked if the actor already gave the first approval.
blockedReasons.modifiedPaymentMethod: Blocked if the actor modified the payment method.
blockedReasons.missingPermission: Blocked when a required permission is missing.
blockedReasons.activeHold: Blocked while a hold is active.
blockedReasons.incompatibleStatus: Blocked when the resource status is not approvable.

payouts.makerCheckerNote: Maker/checker rules are enforced by the API; this screen only explains the reason returned by the server.

create.obligationIdsRequired: At least one obligation ID is required.

detail.title: Payout detail
detail.description: Obligations, holds, approvals, attempts and proof for this payout.
detail.noHolds: No hold is active or recorded.
